# Software Release Recommendation for Extreme Management Center

Source: <https://supportdocs.extremenetworks.com/s_comp_matrices/software-release-recommendation-for-extreme-management-center/>

### Hardware & Software Compatibility Matrices

#### Extreme Management Center Release Recommendation

We recommend a transition from Extreme Management Center to ExtremeCloud IQ – Site Engine.

This recommendation is as of November 2022.

Note: When deploying any software release, customers should always review the Release Notes for known issues that pertain to features and technologies used in their network. Upgrades above these recommendations are suggested only to fix a specific known issue or to implement a required feature not included in the currently recommended release.
